heroDescription: Professional browser-based TWAIN scanning solution powered by Encleso SDK
whatIsGreweScanDescription1: GreweScan is a revolutionary browser-based application that enables TWAIN scanning directly from web browsers using the powerful Encleso SDK. While the web interface requires no installation, the Encleso client software must be installed on the local machine to bridge browser and scanner communication.
whatIsGreweScanDescription2: This hybrid approach provides the convenience of web-based access while maintaining direct hardware communication for optimal scanning performance. GreweScan supports nearly all TWAIN-compatible scanners and works seamlessly across Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Opera browsers on Windows systems.
keyBenefitsList: Web interface with no browser plugins required
Direct scanner communication via Encleso client
Support for nearly all TWAIN-compatible scanners
architectureDescription: GreweScan uses a hybrid architecture where the web application runs in your browser while the Encleso client software installed on your machine handles direct scanner communication through TWAIN drivers.
webInterfaceDesc: Browser-based UI with no plugins required. Works with Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Opera
enclesoClientDesc: Local software that bridges browser and scanner via REST API communication
twainScannerDesc: Direct hardware communication with nearly all TWAIN-compatible scanners
systemRequirementsList: Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Opera)
aboutJSEDesc1: JSE Imaging Solutions is a leading developer of TWAIN development toolkits, TWAIN drivers, TWAIN utilities, and imaging tools with 30 years of innovation in scan and image solutions. They specialize in creating OEM TWAIN and WIA drivers for various manufacturers and provide comprehensive imaging solutions for businesses worldwide.
aboutJSEDesc2: JSE developed the Encleso SDK that powers GreweScan, bringing their decades of TWAIN expertise to modern web-based applications. Their solutions bridge the gap between traditional desktop scanning and contemporary web technologies.

products.SnapTwain: TWAIN driver for Fujitsu and Ricoh ScanSnap scanners (iX100, iX500, iX1300, iX1400, iX1500, iX1600)
products.TWAINCommander: Command line scan utility for batch scanning from any TWAIN compliant device
products.EnclesoSDK: Web TWAIN SDK enabling browser-based scanning applications

poweredByEnclesoDesc: GreweScan is powered by the Encleso SDK, a TWAIN scanning component designed specifically for browser-based web applications. Encleso enables users to select connected scanners, configure settings like resolution and color, and view scanned pages directly within web pages through its JavaScript Library integration.

installation.headerDescription: Follow this step-by-step guide to install Encleso on your computer. The installation process is straightforward and should take only a few minutes to complete.
installation.downloadSectionDescription: Download the latest version of Encleso to begin the installation process.

1.title: Download Encleso
1.description: Click the button above to start downloading Encleso. The download should begin automatically and save to your default downloads folder.

2.title: Open the Downloaded File
2.description: Once the download is complete, navigate to your downloads folder and open the installer file to begin the setup process. The file will typically be named "EnclesoSetup.exe" or similar.

3.title: Welcome Screen
3.description: You will see a welcome screen introducing Encleso. This is the start of the installation process. Read through the welcome message and click "Next" to continue.

4.title: Choose Installation Location
4.description: Next, select the folder where you want to install Encleso. By default, the installer will suggest a location in your Program Files directory. You can change this if you prefer a different location.

5.title: Ready to Install
5.description: After choosing the location, you will see a confirmation screen showing that setup is ready to begin. Review your installation settings and click "Install" when you're ready to proceed.

6.title: Installation in Progress
6.description: Click "Install" and the setup will begin copying files to your computer. A progress bar will show the installation status. Wait until the installation finishes - this usually takes just a few seconds.

7.title: Installation Complete
7.description: Once installation is done, you'll see a final screen confirming completion. You can choose to launch Encleso immediately or click "Finish" to close the installer and launch it later from your applications menu.
